chunks: 2585 - Amir al-Mu'minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام said:

“Jibra'il عليه السلام came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said to him: Indeed, the talbiyah is the slogan of the muhrim, so raise your voice with the talbiyah: Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, inna al-hamda wa al-ni'mata laka wa al-mulk, la sharika laka labbayk.”

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: the formula recited by the pilgrim in ihram declaring response to Allah
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: the person who has entered the state of ihram
key_terms.فَارْفَعْ: raise up; here, raise the voice

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about raising the voice in talbiyah during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Jibra'il عليه السلام instructed the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم that the talbiyah is the distinctive شعار of the person in ihram. It emphasizes proclaiming the talbiyah aloud and affirms tawhid, praise, blessing, and dominion as belonging solely to Allah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2585 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:

" Archangel Jibril (as) came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said to him:
'The Talbiyah is the slogan of the Muhrim, so raise your voice with the Talbiyah:
Labbayka Allahumma Labbayk, Labbayka la sharika laka Labbayk, Inna al-hamda wa al-ni'mata laka wa al-mulk, la sharika laka Labbayk.'"
